title: redfirst report, schema v1
description: The contract between redfirst and the orchestrator. Adding a field is not a breaking change and needs no version bump; renaming or removing one does.

redfirst_version.description: Release of the binary that produced the report.

tier.description: Adoption tier the run operated at.

config_source.description: Whether project rules or built-in ones judged the diff.

base.description: Abbreviated commit id of the base ref.

head.description: Abbreviated commit id of the head ref.

env_mode.description: Environment mode the hooks ran under. Absent below tier 2.

probe_runs.description: How many times each red-green probe ran. Absent below tier 2.

diff_digest.description: Digest of the patch under judgement: the merge base, and what the diff did to every path plus the object it became. Published for the orchestrator to deduplicate attempts; redfirst does not use it.

base_probe_key.description: Digest identifying the base probe: the commit it runs on, the hooks that run it and the head content of the test files it overlays. Absent where no base probe would run. Published so logs can answer whether a cache would have paid off; redfirst does not use it.

verdict.description: Run outcome as a word. The exit code carries the detail.

exit_code.description: 0 pass, 1 gate violation, 2 harness error, 3 invalid config, 4 internal error, 5 no legal move for the agent.

gates.description: One entry per declared gate, in execution order.

warnings.description: Report lines that never change the verdict.

message.description: What is wrong, not what got checked.

reason.description: Why an unavailable or skipped gate did not run. An unavailable result always carries it.

hint.description: How to make an unavailable gate available.

remediation.description: Machine-readable next step. A failing gate always carries it; other statuses leave it empty.

evidence.description: What exactly was violated and where.

base_runs.description: Per-run outcome of the probe on base, in run order.

head_runs.description: Per-run outcome of the probe on head, in run order.

timings.description: The only part of the report that changes between two runs on the same input.
